Change the appearence of the trinkets' companions.

[b]HOW TO INSTALL IT:[/b]

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Extract into your /Stardew Valley/Mods/ folder.
4. Run your game using SMAPI.

To uninstall just delete the folder you put in your Mods directory.

[b]TO CHANGE THE COLOR OF THE BEE:[/b]
(Will be yellow by default)
(Choose Vanilla to not change the fairy)

1. Access the config menu in the principal menu of the game.
2. Click on this mod "Helz's Trinket"
3. Select the option you prefer.
4. Save the changes and enjoy your game.
